metadata.question: Was there more sea ice visible in Hudson Bay (56.271030, -87.160422) on July 29, 2020 than on July 13, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 SAR (C-band) – ice shows bright in HH/HV, cloud-free summer scenes. Collection: COPERNICUS/S1_GRD, orbit direction descending (common), IW mode. Band ratio HH/HV or simple HH gives strong ice contrast; threshold ≥ –19 dB ≡ sea-ice. 2. Area: 200 km buffer around the supplied point over Hudson Bay (coastal ice vs. open water). 3. Dates: 2020-07-13 and 2020-07-29 (±3 days to guarantee at least one image). If one date has no images, fall back to ±5 days, then ±10 days; if still zero → C1. 4. Masking: SAR needs no cloud mask. Mask out land using a 5 km buffer of the Global Self-consistent Hierarchical High-resolution Shorelines (GSHHS) layer so only ocean pixels are counted. 5. Ice detection: Convert HH to dB, apply threshold –19 dB (pixels ≤ –19 dB are ice). Compute total ice pixels (count) for each date. Compare counts; if 2020-07-29 > 2020-07-13 → A, otherwise B. If either count is 0 → C2. If any calculation returns None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-87.160422, 56.271030]) roi = pt.buffer(200000) date1 = ('2020-07-13', '2020-07-16') # ±3 d fallback: 13→16 date2 = ('2020-07-26', '2020-07-29') # ±3 d fallback: 26→29 # 2. Run counts c1 = ice_pixels(date1) if c1 is None: c1 = ice_pixels(('2020-07-10','2020-07-16')) # ±6 c2 = ice_pixels(date2) if c2 is None: c2 = ice_pixels(('2020-07-23','2020-07-29')) # ±6 # 4. Validate & decide if c1 is None or c2 is None: print("Images: 0 (one date)") print("C1") elif c1 == 0 and c2 == 0: print("Valid pixels: 0") print("C2") else: print(f"Jul 13 ice pixels: {c1}, Jul 29 ice pixels: {c2}") print("A" if c2 > c1 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-87.160422, 56.271030])
roi = pt.buffer(200000)
date1 = ('2020-07-13', '2020-07-16')   # ±3 d fallback: 13→16
date2 = ('2020-07-26', '2020-07-29')   # ±3 d fallback: 26→29

# 2. Helper: get ice pixel count
def ice_pixels(drange):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
             .filterBounds(roi)
             .filterDate(*drange)
             .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
             .filter(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'DESCENDING'))
             .select('HH'))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    img = col.mean().clip(roi)
    land = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
    ocean = land.geometry().buffer(5000).bounds().difference(land.geometry())
    water = img.updateMask(ocean)
    db = water.log10().multiply(10.0)   # to dB
    ice = db.lte(-19)                   # ice mask
    count = int(ice.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('HH').getInfo() or 0)
    return count

# 3. Run counts
c1 = ice_pixels(date1)
if c1 is None:
    c1 = ice_pixels(('2020-07-10','2020-07-16'))  # ±6
c2 = ice_pixels(date2)
if c2 is None:
    c2 = ice_pixels(('2020-07-23','2020-07-29'))  # ±6

# 4. Validate & decide
if c1 is None or c2 is None:
    print("Images: 0 (one date)")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif c1 == 0 and c2 == 0:
    print("Valid pixels: 0")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Jul 13 ice pixels: {c1}, Jul 29 ice pixels: {c2}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if c2 > c1 else "<answer>B</answer>")
